hints.title: Periodic Array Simulation
hints.text: The process cycles every 2 * n minutes between progressive front deletion and progressive append replacement.

hints.title: Modulo Time Reduction
hints.text: Compute m = time % (2 * n) to identify whether the array is currently shrinking or regrowing.

hints.title: Direct Index Mapping
hints.text: If m < n, the active array is nums[m:]; if m >= n, the active array is nums[:m - n]. Check index validity.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(Q) constant time modulo evaluation per query
complexity.space: O(1) extra space beyond output array
complexity.notes: The removal and replacement cycle has period 2 * N.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating array mutations for large query timestamps takes O(time * Q) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Taking timestamp modulo 2N directly determines the active subarray window in O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should identify the 2N periodicity and map indices using modular arithmetic.
